title: Concurrent Claude Code Sessions Overwrote ~/.claude.json
caption:
I've been running four Claude Code sessions at once and blaming myself for the settings that kept resetting.

Turns out concurrent sessions were silently reverting each other's ~/.claude.json. Workspace trust, MCP state, project state. Patched Sept 2 in 2.1.259.

I assumed parallel was free because nothing ever errored. It just quietly undid things.

How many sessions do you run?

slides.headline:
Two Sessions,
One Config File
slides.sub: Claude Code sessions running side by side were silently reverting each other's settings. Patched Sept 2.

slides.title: Trust Reset, State Lost
slides.sub: Concurrent sessions overwrote ~/.claude.json. Workspace trust reset and MCP + project state went missing.

slides.title: Four More Races
items: Background sessions started with no plugin skills, and stayed that way, when the marketplace refreshed.
Background sessions kept running an older binary, piling up across auto-updates instead of retiring.
Stopping a background subagent left its monitors running.
Resuming a workflow while its stopped run exited ran duplicate copies of its agents.

slides.headline:
Parallel Is
Not Free
slides.sub: Fan out six sessions and they still share one config file, one binary, one plugin cache.

slides.headline:
Check Your
Version
slides.sub: and I'll send the release notes
